text: Drafted the yolo-twice design in documentation/design.md: a Node/TypeScript monorepo where Claude Code hooks trigger an engine that incrementally reads the session JSONL and writes redacted events and derived data to a project-local .yolo-twice folder. Surveyed Claudescope, claude-code-history-viewer and cc_transcript_viewer, none of which offer semantic zoom, a conversation flow graph or committable project state, so those three become the demo focus, with headless claude -p summaries cached by input hash and a Markdown pitch deck on GitHub Pages. Outcome: the design is a draft with no code scaffolded yet, pending the GitHub org name for the install line and a decision on whether to scaffold the whole monorepo or only the contracts and fixtures.
